stdout:
Native Rust Tsinghua campus and learning services. Use `thu-cli services` to discover operations, or `thu-cli describe thu OPERATION` to inspect arguments. No live login is attempted without an explicit command.

Usage: thu-cli [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

Commands:
  services        List all available service operations and argument descriptions
  describe        Describe a service operation without making a request
  login           Log in using native identity protocol; password is prompted invisibly
  roam            Bootstrap a destination system through the upstream SSO roaming protocol
  thu             Call a campus service. See `services thu` and `describe thu OPERATION`
  learn           Call a Learn service. See `services learn` and `describe learn OPERATION`
  app             App-only washer status, schedule transfer and ICS export
  status          Inspect local cookie metadata; does not claim server authentication
  import-cookies  Import a private Netscape cookie export after interactive browser login
  logout          Clear local session cookies only (does not revoke server-side sessions)
  help            Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
      --session <SESSION>
          Private cookie store path (default: platform user config directory)

      --compact
          Compact machine-readable JSON instead of pretty-printed JSON

  -h, --help
          Print help (see a summary with '-h')

  -V, --version
          Print version
